flora: Mature Sycamore-like trees (massive white/tan mottled trunks, spreading crowns)
Fallen broad leaves on the water surface
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; large, canopy-forming silhouettes; thick trunks; trees clustered near the water's edge to form a natural shade canopy.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of a river bend where massive hardwood trees lean slightly over the water. Their distinct white-and-tan mottled trunks stand out against the vibrant red soil of the riverbank.
visual_logic.ground: Wet muddy brown banks transitioning into the red sandstone of the delta.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, warm sunlight filtering through the broad-leaf canopy, creating large, soft dappled light patterns on the ground and the water.
